newsitem.title: USA: Ameriwood Q4 charge to cut EPS.
newsitem.headline: Ameriwood Q4 charge to cut EPS.

text.p: Ameriwood Industries International Corp said Friday it will record a fourth quarter charge of about $1.0 million to $1.3 million to replace imported futon cushions that may not have met U.S. standards.
Ameriwood, which manufactures unassembled furniture, said the charge will reduce fourth quarter earnings per share by $0.15 to $0.20.
The company said it stopped shipping the futon cushions and is providing replacement cushions that meet U.S. standards.
Ameriwood said it became aware of problems with the cushions when it was performing testing on a similar prototype product made by the same manufacturer.
